@@ -0,0 +1,30 @@
+---
+assignees:
+- claude-code
+depends_on:
+- 01M5QWG18ZZAMS370KT33CTVTY
+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8580'
+title: 'MTP: speculative rejection sampling so MTP runs at temperature > 0'
+---
+## What
+`Qwen35MTPDraftModel.requiresGreedySampling = true` (Libraries/MLXLLM/Models/Qwen35MTP.swift). Thus `MTPSpeculativeTokenIterator.init` changes to plain decode when `temperature != 0`. Typical chat settings for Qwen3.8 are temperature 0.6–1.0 with top-p/top-k, so MTP does not run in real use.
+
+Implement standard speculative sampling (Leviathan et al. 2023 / Chen et al. 2023):
+- [ ] The drafter returns its draft probability distribution q for each draft token, after the same logit processors and top-p/top-k filters as the target. Change `draftMTPTokenBlock` and `sampleMTPSeed` (Libraries/MLXLMCommon/QwenMTP.swift) and the `draftBlock` return type (Libraries/MLXLMCommon/MTPDrafterModel.swift) so that a non-greedy sampler gets the token and q.
+- [ ] Add a pure function `speculativeAccept(targetProbabilities p:, draftProbabilities q:, draftToken:, uniform:)` in a new file Libraries/MLXLMCommon/SpeculativeSampling.swift. It accepts with probability min(1, p/q), and on rejection it samples from normalize(max(p − q, 0)).
+- [ ] In `MTPSpeculativeTokenIterator.speculateRound`, use `speculativeAccept` when the sampler is not greedy. Keep the exact greedy path when temperature is 0. Use the iterator random state so that a seeded run is repeatable.
+- [ ] Set `requiresGreedySampling = false` for Qwen35 MTP (both MLXLLM and MLXVLM Qwen35MTP.swift).
+
+## Acceptance Criteria
+- [ ] At temperature 0, the output is the same as before this task (greedy equality to plain decode is kept).
+- [ ] Over many seeded trials on a small vocabulary, the distribution of the first emitted token with MTP matches the target distribution (chi-square p > 0.01).
+- [ ] At temperature 0.7, top-p 0.95, `qwen38FourBitMTPGeneration` (add a sampled variant) shows MTP tok/s > plain tok/s on the math category.
+
+## Tests
+- [ ] Tests/MLXLMTests/SpeculativeSamplingTests.swift: deterministic tests of `speculativeAccept` with fixed p, q, and uniforms (accept, reject, and resample cases), plus the chi-square distribution test.
+- [ ] Tests/MLXLMTests/Qwen35MTPTests.swift: temperature 0 equality is kept, and the fixture runs at temperature > 0 without a fall back to passthrough.
+- [ ] `swift build --build-tests && xcrun xctest .build/out/Products/Debug/MLXLMTests.xctest` passes.
+
+## Workflow
+- Use `/tdd` — write failing tests first, then implement to make them pass. #mtp #qwen38 #sampling
\ No newline at end of file
